  • Method Details

    • newUpgradeCodec

      HttpServerUpgradeHandler.UpgradeCodec newUpgradeCodec(CharSequence protocol)
      Invoked by HttpServerUpgradeHandler for all the requested protocol names in the order of the client preference. The first non-null HttpServerUpgradeHandler.UpgradeCodec returned by this method will be selected.
      Returns:
      a new HttpServerUpgradeHandler.UpgradeCodec, or null if the specified protocol name is not supported
